Submitter: Mr Yunyi Zhao, Dr Shufan Yang
Board Name: Xilinx VCK190 (Versal AI Core series evaluation kit)
Processor(s) Name: Quad-core ARM Cortex-A72 (APU) + dual-core Cortex-R5 (RPU) + Versal PMC
Processor memory type and capacity: L1 32 KiB I+D per core, 1 MiB shared L2
Accelerator: DPUCVDX8G ISA3 (C32B3) — DPU-only inference path; BN folded into Conv at quantisation
Accelerator memory type and capacity: DPU on-chip caches in PL BRAM/URAM
Hardware Notes: Inference runs entirely on the DPUCVDX8G; the on-board custom INT8 BN-Kernel mapped at 0x80000000 is present but not invoked at inference (it is provided for training). Vitis-AI NNDCT folds every BatchNorm2d into the preceding Conv2d during quantisation, so the deployed xmodel contains zero BN ops.
Other Software Stack: MLCommons Tiny benchmark/runner @ master, driven via a thin wrapper that bypasses USB auto-discovery and points the upstream DUT class at /dev/ttyUSB1 (FT4232HL channel B → VCK190 PS UART /dev/ttyAMA0).
Software Notes: Single C++ binary (vck190_mlperf_dut, built from dut_main.cpp) implements the EEMBC IO protocol and runs in both accuracy and performance modes.
Quantisation Method: Post-training INT8 via Vitis-AI NNDCT (200 calibration batches × 1 image of real CIFAR-10 train data); BN folded into Conv during graph optimisation.
Training framework (open division): PyTorch 2.2 + torchvision 0.17 (CPU). Started from torchvision ResNet18 ImageNet weights, fine-tuned on CIFAR-10 with SGD + OneCycleLR for 4 epochs.
Other Software: MLCommons Tiny benchmark/runner from https://github.com/mlcommons/tiny @ master, commit 5dae329.
Training and Quantisation Notes: Open division: standard ResNet-18 architecture modified for CIFAR-10 (3x3 conv1 stride 1, no maxpool); native 32x32x3 input. Standard CIFAR-10 normalisation used for both training and quantisation calibration: mean=(0.4914, 0.4822, 0.4465), std=(0.2470, 0.2435, 0.2616).
